    condition:
        $http_get and $header_host and $domain_suffix
}

arguments.title: Suspected Cobalt Strike Compromise on WS-FIN-042
arguments.description: Initial low-severity port scan alert escalated. Investigation confirms compromise of WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) via phishing (T1566.001). Adversary executed encoded PowerShell from Outlook, deployed unsigned DLL via rundll32 (T1218.011), and established C2 beacon to known-bad IP 198.51.100.23 on 443/tcp (T1071.001). Lateral movement observed via SMB to 10.0.5.50. Host file modification detected. Source IP 10.0.5.14 in initial alert appears to be a misattribution; true source is WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42). Immediate containment and eradication required.
